messages:
Alex R.: Posting an nsys trace from last night — seen a clear HBM bandwidth throttle during the seq_len=8192 perf run. timeline + raw profile here: https://artifacts.redwood/trace/run1791204827.nsys. Can folks take a quick look?

Priya N.: saw the alert too. HBM reported ~95% BW for ~250ms around the big attention kernels. GPU clocks dipped briefly which matches the perf drop.

Matt C.: dug into the ncu timeline — a lot of short device memcpy H2D spikes overlapping with `conv_attn_fused` kernels. Looks like kv page churn: `kv_cache_evict` has a ton of calls during the window.

Sasha L.: remember we changed kernel selector at 4096 to pick fused path, but above that it flips to the wide-attn path. My hunch: selector is oscillating around the boundary when sequence lengths/pads vary, causing repeated big KV reloads.

Jordan K.: perfetto slice I grabbed shows batching jitter — microbatches from different requests interleave which creates concurrent KV accesses and extra host<->device copies. Also saw walk of small memcpy calls instead of larger coalesced ones.

Alex R.: here's the exact nsys command I ran to reproduce:```nsys profile --output=run1791204827 --trace=cuda,nvtx --sample=cpu --force-overwrite --duration=30s -- python -m perf.runs kv_hbm_matrix.py --seq 8192 --batch 2```

Priya N.: quick experiment: forced the selector to sticky-fused for seq_len >= 6144 — removed the oscillation and KV churn but avg single-request p95 latency rose ~12%. So it's a trade.

Matt C.: proposal: add a hysteresis window to kernel selection (sticky decision for N ms or M tokens) + emit a per-request "kv_page_faults" counter. If we measure eviction churn we can tune cache pinning. I can add lightweight counters in runtime.

Sasha L.: also try increasing microbatch from 1->4 on these workloads; that reduced memcpy frequency in my local runs because we coalesce KV reads. Worth testing on staging.

Jordan K.: note: the NVLink/PCIe transfer pattern in the trace shows many small transfers. If we batch transfers or prefetch KV pages just-in-time we could reduce HBM bus stalls.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: perf-test/kv-hbm-fix started on staging (run id: perf-179120, triggered by @alex) :rocket:

Alex R.: next steps: Matt to add counters + small perf metrics endpoint, Sasha to prototype hysteresis in kernel selector, Priya to run a perf matrix (seq_len x microbatch x sticky) on staging. Jordan to capture a perfetto trace for each run. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PST. :thumbsup:

Priya N.: adding one more note — check quantization path: fused kernels have different memory footprint; quantized models increased HBM pressure in our earlier runs, might be compounding issue.

Matt C.: ack, will include quantized vs fp16 in test matrix.

Sasha L.: I'll push a small A/B to staging with hysteresis=200ms and microbatch=2, will link traces here when done. :eyeglasses:

Alex R.: thanks all — if anyone finds a critical regress in the traces tag the incident channel and escalate.
